name: all_real_ledgers_parse
description: Every real project ledger in the workspace parses without error and produces valid sprints
when: LoadSprints is called on each project
then: All sprints have non-empty ID, title, and valid status (completed/in_progress/planned/skipped)
validates: Parser handles real-world ledger format variations (extra columns, different statuses)

name: status_normalization
description: The 'complete' status variant is normalized to 'completed' in real data
given: energy-tracker project with 'complete' status values in ledger
then: No sprint has raw 'complete' status; at least one has 'completed'
validates: Status normalization works on real production data, not just test fixtures

name: detail_file_resolution
description: Sprint detail markdown files are correctly resolved and readable
when: LoadSprints resolves detail paths and LoadDetailContent reads them
then: Files with DetailPath set are readable and non-empty
validates: File path resolution and content loading work with real directory structures

name: full_render_real_data
description: TUI renders correctly with real project data at standard terminal size
given: Real project sprints loaded into the model
when: WindowSizeMsg(120x40) is sent and View() is called
then: Output contains project name, sprint IDs, and help text
validates: Full data-to-render pipeline works end-to-end with real data

name: navigate_all_sprints
description: Cursor navigation visits every sprint and updates detail content
then: Cursor advances through all sprints without panic, final view renders
validates: Table navigation and detail content updates work for full sprint list

name: large_project_layout
description: Layout renders without panic at various terminal sizes including tiny
then: All render without panic and produce non-empty output
validates: Pane sizing math handles extreme terminal dimensions
